pages.title: Diamond
pages.text: Diamond brings precision as much as hardness. Its Adamant trait improves suitable work and cuts through part of an enemy's protection.

pages.title: Adamant
pages.text: Adamant speeds up blocks the tool is meant to mine and lets attacks ignore part of the target's armour.$(p)$(bold)Suitable blocks:$() 75% faster$(br)$(bold)Armour ignored:$() 30%

pages.title: Emerald
pages.text: Emerald favours a forge master who values what the work yields. Its Fortunate trait improves the level used for Fortune and Looting.

pages.title: Fortunate
pages.text: Fortunate changes the effective level used when drops are calculated.$(p)$(bold)Fortune and Looting:$() 2 levels higher$(br)$(bold)No enchantment installed:$() Behaves as Level II$(br)$(bold)Normal level cap:$() May be exceeded

pages.title: Amethyst
pages.text: Amethyst resonates with magic already held by the finished equipment. Its Resonant trait strengthens one existing enchantment.

pages.title: Resonant
pages.text: Resonant strengthens one enchantment already on the item.$(p)$(bold)Target:$() Highest-level non-curse enchantment$(br)$(bold)Effective level:$() 2 levels higher$(br)$(bold)Unenchanted item:$() No effect

pages.title: Ruby
pages.text: Ruby is an aggressive gem whose two traits favour committed combat and decisive work.

pages.title: Ruby Traits
pages.text: $(bold)Keen$()$(br)Improves suitable-block mining and physical damage.$(p)$(bold)Sanguine$()$(br)Heals from damage dealt, up to one heart per hit.

pages.title: Sapphire
pages.text: Sapphire rewards control under difficult conditions. Its two traits keep work steady and turn danger into power.

pages.title: Sapphire Traits
pages.text: $(bold)Focused$()$(br)Removes the mining penalties for being underwater or airborne.$(p)$(bold)Vital Edge$()$(br)Adds more damage as the wielder loses health, reaching its strongest point near death.

pages.title: Topaz
pages.text: Topaz trades longevity for force and crowd control. Its two traits suit a wielder who wants immediate impact.

pages.title: Topaz Traits
pages.text: $(bold)Forceful$()$(br)Harder hits and faster mining, but faster durability loss.$(p)$(bold)Voltaic$()$(br)Arcs damage to as many as two nearby enemies.
